environment.description: Same NestJS service deployed on ECS Fargate, but the GraphQL API is served exclusively through a CloudFront distribution with Origin Access Control (OAC) configured. The origin (ALB) has a custom header validation: CloudFront injects a secret header 'X-Origin-Verify' with a rotating HMAC value, and the ALB listener rule drops requests missing this header. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution has a CloudFront Function at the viewer-request stage that performs request body inspection on POST requests to /graphql — it parses the JSON body, extracts the 'variables' and inline arguments from the query field, and rejects (403) any request where argument values contain SQL metacharacters (single quotes, semicolons, UNION keyword, comment sequences --) using pattern: /('|;|--|UNION\s+SELECT|OR\s+1\s*=\s*1)/i. The function was deployed via CloudFormation with function ARN association on the default cache behavior. Direct ALB access is blocked by security group allowing inbound only from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing).

config.network: Security group inbound restricted to CloudFront managed prefix list pl-3b927c52
